$comment: The token name dictionary — a closed set of words a name may be composed from. A name can be guessed not because the scheme is written down in the documentation, but because a state is called `hover` EVERYWHERE rather than `hover` here, `over` there and `on-hover` elsewhere (req-token-names). The `check-tokens` gate parses every name against this file and requires every word here to be used — adding a word is therefore a line in a diff that shows up in review, not a quiet widening of the set of acceptable names. The machine will not judge whether a new word is a good one; it only makes sure there is something to judge.

private.$comment: DTCG prefixes excluded from the public `PctCssVar` union in `dist/tokens.ts` (and from `pctTokens` with it). Both the build (the generator's filter) and the gate (point 2) read from here — one declaration instead of an expression buried in the generator that the gate would have to guess at. WHAT BELONGS HERE, settled by decision 0019 (docs/decisions/0019-primitives-are-not-the-contract.md): the primitive COLOUR ramps, and only they. A colour has a semantic tier above it (`--pct-danger`, `--pct-surface`, the `on-` pairs), so a ramp is how this skin happens to be built and not what the library promises; a primitive SCALE has no tier above it, so `--pct-space-3`, `--pct-control-height-md` or `--pct-target-min` are the only name a shared metric has and they stay public.

primitive.$comment: The primitive tier: a name is the DTCG path one to one (`pct.control.height.sm` → `--pct-control-height-sm`), so guessability comes down to knowing the AXES. The axes are listed, the steps are not: `500`, `md`, `medium` belong to their axis, and listing them here would be a second copy of the source file.

semantic.$comment: The semantic tier: `[on-]{role}[-{variant}]`. The `on-` prefix is not a role of its own but the text/background pair rule (req-token-text-pairs) — thanks to which `--pct-on-danger` is guessable from the mere existence of `--pct-danger` rather than from a list.

component.$comment: The component tier: `--pct-{component}[-{part}]-{property}[-{variant}]`. The component is not listed, because it is not a dictionary — it has to be a real package entrypoint (`libs/components/<name>/ng-package.json`), and point 3 watches that. The variant stands ALWAYS at the end: `--pct-button-bg-hover`, never `--pct-button-hover-bg`. That order is the only reason why knowing one name lets you guess its sibling.

sizes.$comment: Size is a variant like a state and stands in the same place — at the end. `md` does not appear in a name, because it is the base value: `--pct-button-height` IS the `md` height (req-api-size).
